subject: Action required: Renewal procurement checklist for Acme Health — term rollforward + capacity uplift
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Dana Price <dana.price@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: procurement checklist + capacity uplift request

Hi Dana,

Hope you had a good week. We're coming up on Acme Health's annual renewal window (term ends 2027-05-31). Based on last quarter's usage signals you crossed the "burst" threshold and we recommended a capacity uplift to avoid throttling during analytics jobs.

To keep the renewal on a single cadence and avoid a pricing amendment later, can you confirm the following items for procurement?

- Preferred contract term: 12 or 24 months (we can run a rollforward for 24 months with a 5% term discount).
- Target capacity (vGPU hours / month) — current committed baseline is 12k tokens/month; suggested uplift to 18k.
- PO process: will you route via procurement@acmehealth.com? Any specific PO template?
- Evidence: Acme requested SOC2 attestation and environment diagram — attached a snapshot of the evidence package we typically provide.

I've attached a draft SOW (Acme_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf) that reflects the 24-month rollforward with the 50% uplift in committed capacity and a price schedule. If it helps, we can prepare a signed copy via DocuSign once you confirm term and PO steps.

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) You confirm term + capacity by Tue 2027-04-13.
2) Procurement sends any required PO template.
3) We send final SOW + invoice lane; you return PO and we push to Billing for invoice processing.

If it's easier, I'm happy to jump on a quick 20-min call with your procurement lead next week.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Acme_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf, redwood-evidence-snapshot-2027.pdf

From: Dana Price <dana.price@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: procurement checklist + capacity uplift request

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear note.

Quick answers:
- Term: procurement prefers 12 months as standard, but we can consider 24 with legal approval.
- Capacity: we are comfortable confirming an uplift to 16k to start (we'll monitor usage, may request another top-up in Q3).
- PO: Yes, route to procurement@acmehealth.com and use our standard template (I've attached the template to this reply).

Oliver (cc) will be the procurement lead on this. He'll run the template and confirm internal approvals timeline — typically 7–10 business days once the SOW + pricing is final.

Can you regenerate the SOW with a 12-month and a 24-month line item (both reflecting the 16k uplift) and mark the preferred billing cadence? Also include an explicit SLA for latency during peak inference windows.

Dana
Head of Technical Procurement | Acme Health
Dana.Price@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_po_template_v2.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Dana Price <dana.price@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: procurement checklist + capacity uplift request

Dana — thanks, that's helpful. Attached is a revised SOW with two options (12m and 24m) both showing a baseline uplift to 16k committed capacity. Highlights included:

- Pricing table: monthly commitment, overage unit rate, and one-time onboarding credit (we can apply the credit on first invoice).
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime SLA for hosted endpoints; latency SLA target (p95 inference) 120ms for standard workloads; escalation path documented.
- Evidence: included the redwood-evidence-snapshot-2027.pdf for SOC2 summary + architecture diagram.

Marissa and Karthik are looped for pricing approval and PO coordination. Marissa — could you confirm the final discount threshold for 24 month commits and whether we can make the one-time onboarding credit conditional on signed PO before 2027-05-15?

If everything looks good, we'll prepare DocuSign and the invoice lane. Once procurement returns a PO we’ll trigger Billing.

Thanks,
Rishi

Attachment: Acme_Renewal_SOW_v3_REVISED.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Price <dana.price@acmehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: procurement checklist + capacity uplift request

Rishi / Karthik — on pricing there is a path to approve the 24-month at 5% term discount, but only if Acme signs the PO by 2027-05-15 and commits to the uplift to 16k or higher. The onboarding credit can be included but must be applied on invoice after PO is received.

Karthik — please prepare the final SOW with the change log and mark the 24m and 12m price lines. Also add a short paragraph clarifying data residency and audit support (Acme had asked on that point).

Dana / Oliver — once you return the PO to procurement@acmehealth.com we'll route to Billing and Legal for countersign. ETA from our side for DocuSign is ~1 business day after final SOW.

I'll also attach a quick internal checklist for Billing so there are no delays (PO number format, contact for invoice routing).

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: billing-checklist-acme.pdf
